comments.author: Lancelot
comments.body:
For those trying to complete memorial album for "Enjoy the Taste of Shrimp" you can't buy this dish from any clerk... you have to cook it. Luckily, if you have the proper rank or mysterious spices, you can get all the stuff in SE asia:

Garlic can be bought in Gia Dinh
Tumeric can be bought in Pattani (same place where you invest to get book)
Can easily collect Shrimp in SE Asia waters
